hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE 'cargo +(nextest +run|test)\b[^|;&]*(-p|--package)[ =]' && { echo 'BLOCKED: do not run tests per-crate. Run the whole suite: cargo nextest run. Per-crate runs miss the shared build cache and are SLOWER, not faster.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE 'git +(checkout|commit|rebase|stash)' && { echo 'BLOCKED: do not run destructive git operations. Let the human do that.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE 'sed -i ' && { echo 'BLOCKED: edit files directly. When you use sed, you frequently make unintended changes and corrupt files.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Checking sed used for file edits
